info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Portfolio Allocation-spec
info.description: The Portfolio Allocation Management API enables users to effectively manage and update allocation settings within specific investment portfolios. Through this endpoint, stakeholders can adjust the allocation parameters for a given portfolio identified by its unique portfolioId. This API is essential for portfolio managers and financial institutions looking to maintain optimal investment strategies and respond to market changes efficiently. Use cases may include reallocating funds to different asset classes or adjusting risk profiles as needed.

put.summary: Update the allocations of a specific portfolio.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the allocation settings for a specific portfolio identified by its unique resource ID. Make sure to provide the necessary details in the request body to update the allocations accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the allocations for a specific portfolio identified by RES-100045. It should contain the necessary information required to modify the allocation details, adhering to the defined schema.
